selection_rule.confirmation: For each registry family, prefer accepted protocol-v4 confirmations; if none exists, use accepted confirmations of any protocol version. Accepted means acceptance-summary verdict accepted, regardless of qualifies.
selection_rule.ordering: Within that pool choose the greatest sequence of the campaign's reservation in its receipt-pinned family ledger prefix. A receipt without a ledger sorts before ledger-backed receipts. Ties use protocol version, campaign identity, then repository-relative receipt path, lexicographically greatest; no Git date, file timestamp or live ledger is used.
selection_rule.cells: Emit every confirmatory and holdout cell in the selected pinned addendum. If no accepted confirmation exists, select the latest accepted pilot by the same ordering and emit all its cells as exploratory. Smoke receipts are excluded. Registry patterns, minus their explicit exclusions, expand against the pinned addenda's declared family identities.
selection_rule.primary: A confirmatory or holdout cell is primary exactly when either of its two plan arms has the registry's external build identity. Exploratory cells are never primary; external_arms still records their external comparisons.
selection_rule.pending: A registry entry with no accepted confirmation or pilot emits no cells and is recorded under pending. Distinct declared family identities remain distinct.
selection_rule.domains: A registry entry supplies the domain, with matching workload-identity overrides partitioning families shared by several domains.

pending.context_only: Criterion evidence is historical context under design decision D-2; no protocol confirmation cells.
